name: Dethrace
description:
dethrace is a reverse-engineered, open-source source port of Carmageddon (1997), the iconic vehicular combat and racing game. It reconstructs the original game logic to execute natively on modern operating systems without DOS emulation.

Features:
- Native execution on modern 64-bit systems with high framerates
- High-resolution rendering with support for widescreen and modern display scaling
- Full physics-driven vehicular collisions and destructible car geometry
- Modern controller and steering wheel configuration alongside keyboard controls
- Requires original Carmageddon game data files to run
